## About
Budget Auto Painting is a locally owned and operated body shop on Buford Hwy in Chamblee. It has been under the same ownership since the day it opened, and we work on all makes and models of import and domestic vehicles, from everyday cars to commercial fleet vehicles, classic cars and special interest autos.
Whether it's a small ding or damage from a serious collision, our job is to get your car looking and driving the way it did before. We can also deal with your car insurance company for you, so you have one less thing to sort out after an accident.
Our customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 139 Google reviews. Stop by the shop or give us a call to talk about your car.

## Services
- Collision and auto body repair: From minor dings to damage after a serious collision, we repair the body of your car so it looks and drives the way it should.
- Color match and custom auto painting: Color matching so repaired panels blend with the rest of your car, plus custom paint work.
- Frame straightening and unibody repair: Structural repair for cars with a bent or shifted frame after an accident.
- Paintless dent repair: A way to work small dents out of the metal while keeping the factory finish in place.
- Car restoration: Restoration work to bring a special interest car back to life.
- Media blasting
- Fleet vehicle repairs: Body and paint work for commercial fleet vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call to set up a free estimate for your auto body repair.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We can deal with your car insurance company for you, which can cut down on stress and your out of pocket expenses.

Q: Do I have to use the shop my insurance company recommends?
A: No. A lot of drivers think they have to use the shop their insurance company recommends, but you have the right to choose where your vehicle is repaired.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Chamblee and serve drivers from Dunwoody, Brookhaven, Norcross, Sandy Springs, Roswell, Smyrna and John's Creek.
